name: Upper Back Stretch
steps: Stand or sit tall, interlace your fingers in front of your chest, and turn your palms facing outward away from you.
Extend both arms straight forward at shoulder height while gently rounding your upper back and spreading your shoulder blades wide apart.
Tuck your chin slightly toward your chest until you feel a broad, relieving stretch across your upper back between your shoulder blades.
Hold the stretch calmly with slow breaths into your upper back, then unclasp your hands gently to release.
tips: Keep your shoulders relaxed down away from your ears even while reaching forward.
Reach your hands away from your breastbone while allowing your shoulder blades to spread.
